quote: T5 consists of an encoder-decoder Transformer  with minor modifications . The model is trained simultaneously on multiple tasks, obtaining state-of-the-art performance across a diverse set of tasks. We use the T5 framework as it enables training a universal model that interfaces with many language tasks.
outputs: The model frames text-based language tasks as sequence-to-sequence problems.

quote: For MNLI, we report accuracy on the matched validation set. For MRPC and QQP, we report accuracy and F1. For STS-B, we report Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients. For CoLA, we report Matthews correlation. For all other tasks, we report accuracy.
